input.quote: This Agreement and the performance of transactions under this Agreement shall be governed by the substantive laws of the state of New York.
input.rationale: Section 16.9 selects New York substantive law and requires any action to be commenced "in a court sited within the State of New York" — courts, not arbitration. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document, and the ancillary general clauses (CI Agreement Section 8, p1499, and Loan Agreement Section 16, p1587) also choose New York law, so there is no conflicting law or venue selection. This meets the preferred position (New York law with New York courts). Minor points short of the preferred wording, noted only: venue is not expressly the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, and the clause adds a contractual limitations period; neither is material and neither is redlined.
